technical_and_design_decisions: Adopt a modular architecture where each data source/sink is implemented as a separate, self-contained module following Spring XD's existing plugin patterns.
For JDBC source: Use Spring's JdbcTemplate for database access, with configurable connection pooling and support for common databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, H2).
For Redis sink: Utilize Spring Data Redis with Lettuce client library for high-performance, asynchronous Redis writes.
For Kafka sink: Implement using Spring for Apache Kafka and KafkaTemplate, with configurable producer properties.
For ZooKeeper security: Leverage ZooKeeper's built-in ACL system with SASL authentication and IP-based restrictions.
For extensible Trigger abstraction: Design an abstract base class with clear extension points, following template method pattern.
For HTTPS support: Update Spring Boot dependency to 1.1.7 and configure embedded server SSL properties via application.yml.
For E2E tests: Refactor Grunt configuration to isolate server and test processes, using appropriate lifecycle hooks.
assumptions: The development environment includes standard Spring XD build infrastructure (Gradle/Maven, existing module templates).
Existing modules (like file source, log sink) serve as reference implementations for new modules.
The Spring XD codebase is already cloned and configured locally.
ZooKeeper nodes requiring ACL are already identified in the codebase.
The E2E test infrastructure (Grunt, Protractor) is set up and functional for individual process execution.
SSL certificates for HTTPS testing can be generated locally (self-signed).
Redis, Kafka, and JDBC drivers are available in the build dependencies repository.
All activities are performed by a single developer with Spring XD expertise.

Implement ACL configuration for ZooKeeper nodes, including authentication setup, permission models, and integration tests to verify access restrictions.
Refactor Trigger abstraction to support extension via abstract base class and interfaces. Includes documentation for custom trigger implementation and unit tests.
Create a complete example module demonstrating custom module development, including step-by-step documentation, build configuration, and deployment instructions.
Design and implement Kafka sink module supporting topic/partition configuration, serialization, error handling, and transaction support. Includes unit/integration tests.
Fix the 'socket hang up' error by refactoring Grunt configuration to properly separate server and test processes. Includes debugging, configuration updates, and verification.
Enable HTTPS for admin server by updating Spring Boot dependency, configuring SSL properties, creating test certificates, and verifying secure endpoints.
